page.overview:
Who is Jimmy Cables?

Jimmy Cables is one of the Piston Cup racers competing at the Motor Speedway of the South where he finishes 10th, then as the next-generation racers have rose, this makes Jimmy to be fired from racing and gets replaced by a Next-Gen Intersection racer named Flip Dover.
